business_summary: SMC Corporation manufactures and sells automatic control equipment in Japan, the United States, China, rest of Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company offers air management system, directional control valves, air cylinders, rotary actuators/air grippers/magnet grippers, electric actuators/cylinders, vacuum equipment, air grippers for collaborative robots, compact compressor, air preparation equipment, modular F.R.L., pressure control equipment, booster regulators, lubrication equipment, gas generator, fittings and tubing, flow control equipment, speed controllers, silencers/exhaust cleaners/pressure gauges, and air blowing equipment. It also provides switches/sensors/controllers, static neutralization equipment/ionizers, industrial device communication equipment/wireless system, process valves, chemical valves/fittings and tubing/needle valves, process pumps/diaphragm pumps, temperature control equipment, process gas equipment AP tech, high vacuum equipment, industrial filters/sintered metal elements, pneumatic instrumentation equipment, hydraulic equipment, and specialized products for general use. In addition, the company offers clean series/low-particle generation, fluoropolymer equipment PVC equipment, series compatible with secondary batteries series 25A-, and copper, fluorine-free equipment series 20-; ISO, IO-link compatible, and ATEX compliant products; arc welding process and grease-free nitrogen (N2) compatible equipment; equipment for food manufacturing and semiconductor industries; and pickup contents. It serves automobiles, semiconductor/liquid crystal/electric, machine tool, food/beverages, physicochemical/medical/pharmaceutical, agriculture, energy, production facility, and other industries. The company was formerly known as Shoketsu Kinzoku Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SMC Corporation in April 1986. SMC Corporation was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: SMC Corporation은 일본, 미국, 중국, 기타 아시아 지역, 유럽 및 국제적으로 자동 제어 장비를 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 공기 관리 시스템, 방향 제어 밸브, 에어 실린더, 로터리 액추에이터/에어 그리퍼/마그넷 그리퍼, 전동 액추에이터/실린더, 진공 장비, 협동 로봇용 에어 그리퍼, 소형 압축기, 공기 준비 장비, 모듈식 F.R.L., 압력 제어 장비, 부스터 조절기, 윤활 장비, 가스 발생기, 피팅 및 튜빙, 유량 제어 장비, 속도 컨트롤러, 소음기/배기 청소기/압력 게이지 및 공기 송풍 장비를 제공합니다. 또한, 스위치/센서/컨트롤러, 제전장비/이오나이저, 산업용 기기 통신장비/무선 시스템, 프로세스 밸브, 케미컬 밸브/피팅 및 튜빙/니들 밸브, 프로세스 펌프/다이어프램 펌프, 온도 조절 장비, 프로세스 가스 장비 AP 기술, 고진공 장비, 산업용 필터/소결 금속 요소, 공압 계측 장비, 유압 장비 및 일반 용도의 특수 제품을 제공합니다. 또한, 당사는 클린 시리즈/저발진형 불소계 제품을 제공하고 있습니다.
